IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long, straight black
hair flowing slightly to one side stands in a
full-length pose against a pale studio backdrop.
She wears a fitted heathered gray ribbed turtleneck
mini dress with long sleeves, cinched at the waist
with a thin brown leather belt. Tall tan suede
knee-high boots with buckle detail and a pointed
toe complete the look. Her expression is calm and
direct. Soft, even studio light with a glossy floor.
Palette of heathered gray, chocolate, and tan.
Clean and cozy, in the style of a minimalist winter
lookbook.
